newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST-Danish June c/a, trade surplus seen up.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Danish June c/a, trade surplus seen up.

text.p: Six economists polled by Reuters on Friday said they expected Denmark's June current account and foreign trade surpluses to be higher on average than in May.
The national statistics office will release both June current account and foreign trade data on September 10 at 0730 gmt.

The panel predicted an average June current account surplus of 2.5 billion crowns, well up on May's 0.9 billion crowns, with the foreign trade surplus without ships at an average 3.8 billion crowns slightly higher than the previous month's 3.7 billion crowns surplus.
Low and high estimates were 1.8-3.5 billion crowns for the current account surplus, with the span between 3.2-4.8 billion crowns for foreign trade excluding ships for June.
